"""Check actual packaged whole-novel cache parity in all three dictionary modes."""
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/home/josh/projects/klem');sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'tools'))
from copula_expectation_production import read,sha
package=read('docs/copula-expectation-packaged-checks.json');cli=Path(package['nix_outputs']['klem'])/'bin/klem';book=ROOT/'data/books/mujeong.txt';db=ROOT/'data/dictionaries/krdict/krdict.db';assert sha(cli)==package['cli_sha256'];streams=[]
for mode,flags in [('raw',[]),('headword',['--dict-only']),('compatible',['--dict-compatible'])]:
 expected=next(r for r in package['comparisons'] if r['mode']=='novel-'+mode);checks=[]
 assert sha(book)==expected['source_sha256']
 for cache in [0,8388608]:
  command=[str(cli),'text',str(book),'--dictionary',str(db),*flags,'--cache-bytes',str(cache)];process=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=ROOT,stdout=subprocess.PIPE);digest=hashlib.sha256();count=0
  try:
   for line in process.stdout:digest.update(line);count+=1
   code=process.wait();assert code==0
  finally:
   if process.poll() is None:process.terminate();process.wait()
  assert count==expected['records']==179112 and digest.hexdigest()==expected['after_jsonl_sha256'];checks.append({'command':command,'exit_code':code,'records':count,'sha256':digest.hexdigest()});print(mode,cache,count,'frames; exact packaged expected hash.',flush=True)
 streams.append({'mode':mode,'checks':checks})
p=Path(__file__);out=Path('/tmp/klem-copula-expectation-cache-parity.json');assert not out.exists();out.write_text(json.dumps({'schema_version':1,'cli_sha256':sha(cli),'book_sha256':sha(book),'dictionary_sha256':sha(db),'package_sha256':sha(ROOT/'docs/copula-expectation-packaged-checks.json'),'streams':streams,'producer':{'text':p.read_text(),'sha256':sha(p)}},indent=2)+'\n')
